Laurey 52066, Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The Oil Rubbed Bronze Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull is ideal for traditional kitchens. The Oil Rubbed Bronze finish is all at once modern and classic. This Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet cup pull is part of the Laurey Nantucket Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 52066 3 Inch Pull Nantucket Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
